title: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana – Bihar Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Bihar government health assurance pathway linked to the state's implementation of government-funded hospitalization coverage for eligible households.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Bihar residents/households meeting the current state beneficiary criteria and applicable PM-JAY/state rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana – Bihar.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
